valores.label: Land John Pfeiffer sold to the State in 1934
Pfeiffer Big Sur State Park, size given in the 1986 plan

fonte: Monterey County, Big Sur Coast Land Use Plan (Local Coastal Program), 1986 (cópia do govinfo, CZIC)
texto_para_tela: 1934 · 706 ACRES SOLD TO THE STATE | FINISHED JUNE 27, 1937
credito_sugerido: Source: Monterey County, Big Sur Coast Land Use Plan, 1986
nota: P [1235]: 'sold 706 acres to the State for the nucleus of the 822-acre Pfeiffer Big Sur State Park'. A tela do espelho, 'PFEIFFER BIG SUR STATE PARK · 1934 · 706 ACRES', lê-se como se o parque tivesse 706 acres; o plano diz que eles foram o núcleo de um parque de 822. Sugiro o nome do parque como rótulo do lugar e o número preso à venda. P [1232]: 'On June 27,1937, the highway was completed'.
licenca: fato e citação curta, com atribuição (uso editorial), recriados no visual do canal; a página do plano não vai à tela sem a licença do documento lida (marca/midia.md §7.1; a folha recriada é do pesquisa-documentos)

pedidos.pedido: P [1235]: 'initiated by John Pfeiffer in 1934 when he sold 706 acres to the State' (R124); 'The process of ensuring the long-term protection of Big Sur's unique coastline was initiated by John Pfeiffer in 1934' (R125). P [1232] (medição): 'On June 27, 1937, the highway was completed' (R126). Tela PFEIFFER BIG SUR STATE PARK · 1934 · 706 ACRES; FINISHED JUNE 27, 1937.

citacoes_relidas.trecho: initiated by John Pfeiffer in 1934 when he sold 706 acres to the State for the nucleus of the 822-acre Pfeiffer Big Sur State Park
On June 27,1937, the highway was completed at a cost of approximately $8,000,000

divergencias: 706 acres são a venda de 1934 (o núcleo); o parque tem 822 acres no plano. A tela do espelho pode ler como o tamanho do parque
